name: language_baseline_personal_narrative
license: CC-BY-4.0 (SocialGrep); Reddit content subject to Reddit User Agreement — do not re-host raw text
coverage: 12,000 r/confession(+adjacent) posts, randomly sampled from a 340,000-row shard; median 1,018 characters (min 300)
notes: First-person written accounts of real personal events — the closest WAKING analogue to a dream report in person, tense and register. Used ONLY as a matched natural-language comparator for the intrinsic-dimension and percolation estimators, so that the geometry claims are benchmarked against ordinary human language and not only against synthetic nulls.
caveats: Self-selected, English, Reddit-specific register. Posts marked [removed]/[deleted] were dropped. `author` holds the post id, not the Reddit username, so the file carries no account identifier. Documents are far longer than the 256-character embedding window, so the geometry script also runs a LENGTH-MATCHED variant that truncates each document to a character count drawn from the Dreamseer English distribution.
